groups.title: Therapeutic massage

items.name: Sensory scalp, shoulder & face massage
items.desc: A slow, layered ritual of hair brushing, gentle shoulder work and facial massage, 65 minutes

items.name: The Go and Glow
items.desc: A 35-minute mini facial with a consultation for new clients: double cleanse, a mask and finishing products

items.name: 60 Minute Basic Facial
items.desc: Deep cleanse, exfoliation, facial massage and a mask

items.name: Signature Facial
items.desc: Organic handmade products from Hawaii Nei, hot stone massage and tropical ingredients, 90 minutes

items.name: Microdermabrasion Facial
items.desc: A diamond-tip wand exfoliates for smoother, brighter skin, 75 minutes. Stay out of the sun for a few days after

items.name: Dermaplane Facial
items.desc: Gentle exfoliation that removes dead skin and peach fuzz, 90 minutes

items.name: Carboxy Facial
items.desc: An oxygenating facial for acne-prone or dull skin and signs of aging, 90 minutes

items.name: 60-minute massage & 60-minute facial
items.desc: An hour of massage and an hour of facial, with Maria and Kay

items.name: Reconnect Through Touch
items.desc: A couples massage class: learn simple techniques to relax each other, 150 minutes. $100 deposit required

sections.title: Recovery *and renewal*

image.alt: Hands working on a client’s leg during a massage, in black and white

body: Massage-ology is a wellness studio on Silver Bluff Road in Aiken, offering therapeutic and medical massage that supports recovery and improves mobility, alongside facials tailored to your skin.
Massage and facial services are with Maria and Kay. Book online any day of the week, or call the studio.

A client relaxing during a facial with a cream mask

items.a: Yes, therapeutic massage is provided by a licensed therapist.
Yes, in 30, 60 and 90-minute sessions designed for expectant mothers.

Monday 10 am to 4 pm, Tuesday to Friday 10 am to 8 pm, and Saturday and Sunday 8 am to 8 pm.

before: The studio’s only site is a booking-app page, with “AIken” misspelled in the title and the address
The header cuts the studio’s name off at “MASSAGE-…”
The same 60-minute therapeutic massage is listed twice, at $120 and at $100
On a phone, the first screen shows no phone number or call button
A 7.0 MB home page: in Google’s slow-phone test the main picture takes 22.3 seconds, and the mobile score is 36 out of 100
after: A site of its own, with every service and price in one list
Hours with an “Open now” sign, and one tap to call
Massage, facials and the couples class explained
